name: rabench-format
notes: Fresh RA-Bench scene pairs, with real and generated inputs standardized to 504×504, 24 fps and 96 frames. Each clip's two encodes start directly from one lossless master. Read configs/rabench-format-selection.md for the selection rule. Report ordering and fixed 0.5 errors, with no fitted cutoff. Crop and resampling change the inputs, and comparison to the previous native pilot uses different clips.
